intro.text: The ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) is a globally recognised professional accountancy qualification originating in the United Kingdom. It equips students and professionals with the knowledge and skills required to succeed in financial accounting, management accounting, auditing, taxation, financial reporting and business management.

runs.text: The ACCA qualification combines technical accounting knowledge with professional ethics, business understanding and practical experience, preparing learners for careers in accounting and finance across a wide range of industries.
